name: 22-pf-member-left-out-now-in-band
why: Someone with PF wages of 20,000 who is not a PF member, after the ceiling rose from 15,000 to 25,000: no PF is deducted, and a warning asks HR to check whether they must now be covered. (Starts this month, so there is no income earlier in the tax year and the new-regime rebate covers the six months projected: no TDS.)
